title: Option Deposit Relief for Calloway Home Mortgage Financing — Design Studio Selections
content:
**Programme term.** The line deposit of a Design Studio Selections file is reduced by a lender relief percent set by the financing of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

- where the agreement is financed through Calloway Home Mortgage and the Builder Extended Rate Lock on that agreement is locked, the line deposit is reduced by 10 percent;
- where the agreement is financed through Calloway Home Mortgage and no rate lock on that agreement is locked, it is reduced by 5 percent;
- where the agreement is financed by an outside lender or by cash, there is no relief.

**Records read.** The financing type on the Home Purchase Agreement and the status of the Builder Extended Rate Lock held on that agreement.

| Financing | Builder Extended Rate Lock on the agreement | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Locked | 10 percent |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | In any status other than locked, or no lock | 5 percent |
| Outside lender | Any | None |
| Cash | — | None |

*Hypothetical figure:* a line deposit of 9125.00 with a locked rate lock through Calloway Home Mortgage is reduced by 10 percent to 8212.50.
